reason: A Feishu and Lark communication channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness that supports WebSocket messaging, multimodal file exchange, persistent chat sessions, commands, and in-chat tool approvals.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入飞书和国际版 Lark，支持聊天消息、图片与文件收发、会话管理及聊天内工具审批。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Feishu and Lark with chat messaging, image and file exchange, session management, and in-chat tool approvals.

capabilities: Connects to Feishu and Lark through the official Node SDK and WebSocket transport
Receives direct and group chat messages, including text, rich text, images, and files
Sends model text replies, generated images, and workspace files to chats
Maintains persistent per-chat Harness sessions and supports slash commands
Handles one-shot tool approval and rejection decisions through chat commands
